summary: Extended the safety-axis lead with the two faults the answered reordering question did not cover: duplication of replication messages, and replay of a replaced leader's messages after the survivors have moved to a newer ballot. The new probe reuses the same in-process core driver plus a transport fault layer (hold-from, duplicate-to, replay-held) and runs a control, a duplication case that delivers every message addressed to node 2 twice, and a stale-replay case that cuts the leader off so the followers elect node 3, then restores the link and replays every retained message from the old leader. Locally all three cases end with the same decided values (1,2,3,7,8,9) on all three nodes — 507 messages were replayed in the stale case and all nodes ended following node 3 — so the submitted execution is a bounded negative pair with the receipts as evidence. Incomplete: that receipt is pending; both new comparisons carry applicability conditions keyed to the reported fault fields so an ineffective fault cannot be scored as a pass.
